quote: Our research presents a novel framework for transferring code knowledge from closed-source LLMs to open-source LLMs. This framework is designed to generate code responses for various coding instructions during the data synthesis process.

Recently, the powerful proprietary large language models (LLMs)... have showcased impressive code generation ability. ... Our work introduces a novel method for more effectively distilling code knowledge ... thereby enhancing the coding performance.
